messages.subject: UTF-8 text encoding?
messages.body_plain:
Dear Ian,

I really like Deducer: it is a quite helpful tool for using R in a friendly way. Congratulations for your great work.

I wonder if Deducer can be configured with text encoding UTF-8 in order to allow particular Spanish characters to be handled in labels, filenames, etc. Symbols like ó, ñ, are not displayed properly. In fact, I spent a lot of time figuring out that Deducer (i.e. R) was not able to open a folder because it had an "ñ" in its name! :-(

Thanks.

Jorge Navarro
Departamento de Ecologia
Universidad Autonoma de Yucatan
Merida, Yucatan, México

messages.subject: Remove legend from plots
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

Working on creating plots and then once parameters are set I will try to
create a template for use for all of the necessary plots.

I have been doing a lot of Trial & Error with the Legend section of
Theme in Plot Builder but can not eliminate the legend.  I can remove
the text, rectangles and virtually everything but the points remain on
the right (default).  Both the X - Y Axes have the necessary
information, therefore the legend is redundant.  So I would like to
remove it.

Clearly I am missing something basic here.

Cheers,

Bruce
